data.one_liner: A common platform interface for the speech_to_text plugin.
data.what_it_does: Defines a common platform interface for the speech_to_text plugin, allowing platform-specific implementations to ensure they support the same interface. It handles options like contextual phrases and device support checking.
use_when: You are developing a platform-specific implementation of the speech_to_text plugin.
avoid_when: You are just building a standard Flutter app that wants to use speech recognition (use the main speech_to_text plugin instead).
strengths: Provides a standardized interface for speech_to_text platform implementations.
weaknesses: Not intended for direct use by standard application developers.
